subject: a tiny chair inside an open wooden box

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make an unmarked small wooden box into a miniature room with one cream chair and pale-blue paper walls. Keep the lid open behind it and view the box three-quarter, allowing the interior to read clearly at small size. Show wood grain and folded corners under soft window-like light. Use a quiet neutral background with no tiny books or decorative clutter. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
